rootCause: BG184 polls hourly and treated an unchanged open social obligation as a fresh error every run. Its unresolved branch directly invoked BG168 and the GREEN-UNTIL-DONE recovery orchestrator without caller-side blocker state, aging or dedupe.
failedApproaches: Rely on BG168 internal materiality or BG166 learning dedupe; the paid BG168 invocation and recovery-orchestrator invocation have already happened by then.
Slow the whole BG184 schedule merely to save credits; that degrades detection freshness for genuinely new obligations.
Use shared Notion Laatste run as a new blocker-dedupe ownership field without proving exclusive ownership.
Treat scenario inactive/paused status as the permanent solution; callable or later-reactivated control-plane paths still require internal guards.
Suppress the blocker forever after first observation; unresolved obligations still need bounded escalation and state-change responsiveness.

containment.stagingName: STAGING - BG184 Stateful Blocker Dedupe v2
containment.design: Caller-side Make Data Store reservation before BG168 and recovery orchestration, keyed by record id, blocker state hash and six-hour bucket. Duplicate reservation terminates the unresolved branch before paid downstream dispatch. Changed state generates a new reservation identity immediately.

preventionRules: Persist a caller-side reservation before BG168 and recovery-orchestrator dispatch, keyed by record plus blocker state plus bounded time bucket.
Known unchanged blockers are stateful obligations, not new errors on every watcher tick.
Keep sensing cadence independent from expensive escalation cadence; do not reduce detection freshness just to lower cost.
A real blocker-state change must bypass prior-state dedupe by producing a new state hash.
Periodic escalation must remain bounded and explicit; six-hour buckets are the current staging policy, not an implicit infinite suppression.
Do not repurpose a shared business field for control-plane dedupe without proving field ownership.
Do not promote from blueprint readback or CI green alone; controlled runtime evidence and bounded credit slope are mandatory.

regressionContract.duplicateReservation: zero BG168 calls and zero governed recovery calls
regressionContract.changedState: new state hash may dispatch immediately

regressionContract.notDueBranch: behaviorally equivalent to current BG184 production
